name: Bird Protection Fund
summary: Annual grants for Wisconsin bird conservation, including creating and protecting breeding, stopover and overwintering habitat, with priority for boreal and grassland bird habitat. Charities, tribes, governments and universities can apply.

geography.label: Wisconsin's birds, from breeding grounds in Wisconsin to migratory habitat in Central and South America

calls.label: Annual grant cycle
calls.recurring: Applications are due by 1 July each year.

status.quote: Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by July 1.

recurring.quote: Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by July 1.

applicant_types.quote: Applicant must be one of the following: a public charity with approved 501(c)(3) exempt status (under section 509(a)(1), 509(a)(2), or 509(a)(3) Type I and Type II); a federal, state, or local governmental unit, an American Indian nation or tribal community; or an accredited college or university.

geography.quote: The Bird Protection Fund supports the highest priority conservation needs for Wisconsin's birds throughout their lifecycle - from their breeding grounds in Wisconsin to their migratory habitat in Central and South America.

access.quote: Complete the application (paper copies of applications are not accepted).

window.quote: Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by July 1.
